cases.name: accept_resting_buy
cases.pass: broker accepts the non-marketable limit and the engine ledger records it submitted with a broker id and an open status

cases.name: cancel_resting
cases.pass: engine ledger records canceled with zero fill and a fresh broker snapshot shows the order canceled

cases.name: cancel_again
cases.pass: second engine cancel raises nothing, adds no transport freeze reason and leaves the ledger intent, fills and positions unchanged; whether a DELETE was sent and refused is recorded, not assumed; without a DELETE the evidence class is engine_short_circuit

cases.name: definitive_rejection
cases.pass: a sub-penny limit reaches the broker, is refused with a definitive 401/403/404, and the engine ledger records broker_refused with no position or cash effect; unobserved when the engine refuses or rounds before any request reaches the broker

stop_rule: stop after the first failed or errored case; never retry a write
cleanup: cancel every non-terminal ledger intent carrying this run's client-id prefix on the same started transport, then prove flat and zero open orders with runner.reconcile over a fresh transport snapshot; otherwise write CLEANUP_REQUIRED
pass_status: native_faults_passed requires every case passed with native_paper evidence and a proven flat cleanup
